fields.label: Vision text
fields.name: vision_text
fields.default_value: To become Africa's most trusted independent institution for ideas, scholarship, and public discourse — advancing an intellectual renaissance that shapes ethical leadership, resilient institutions, technological innovation, and sustainable development.

fields.label: Vision note
fields.name: vision_note
fields.default_value: Trust is more valuable than popularity. Influence is more enduring than visibility.

fields.label: Mission text
fields.name: mission_text
fields.default_value: To cultivate rigorous analysis, independent thought, and evidence-based dialogue that strengthens Africa's intellectual life, informs public policy, and equips society to address the defining challenges of the 21st century.

fields.label: Mission note
fields.name: mission_note
fields.default_value: Every article should educate. Every publication should illuminate. Every debate should elevate.

fields.label: Vision & Mission background colour
fields.name: vm_bg_color
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the site's brand colour.

fields.label: Step 1 — text
fields.name: story_1_text
fields.default_value: Africa's public discourse is too often dominated by immediate events rather than enduring principles — news rewards speed over reflection, opinion over evidence.

fields.label: Step 2 — text
fields.name: story_2_text
fields.default_value: ARR was founded in direct response to this challenge: to cultivate thoughtful analysis and evidence-based dialogue rooted in African realities.

fields.label: Step 3 — text
fields.name: story_3_text
fields.default_value: Not a daily wire service, but a home for depth — long-form essays, research translation, and ideas built to outlast the headlines that inspired them.

fields.label: Value 1 — text
fields.name: value_1_text
fields.default_value: The foundation of public trust, pursued with disciplined research and honesty.

fields.label: Value 2 — text
fields.name: value_2_text
fields.default_value: Editorial judgment free from partisan, commercial, or ideological influence.

fields.label: Value 3 — text
fields.name: value_3_text
fields.default_value: Continuous learning and work that meets the highest international standards.

fields.label: Value 4 — text
fields.name: value_4_text
fields.default_value: Consistency between principle and practice across every process.

fields.label: Value 5 — text
fields.name: value_5_text
fields.default_value: Openness to dialogue, recognising that reasonable people may disagree.

fields.label: Value 6 — text
fields.name: value_6_text
fields.default_value: Publishing what is true and necessary, even when it is uncomfortable.
